about_the_game:
A serious adventure. A serious goal. A serious game.

It matters not that a terrifying evil has descended on this world. It matters not that entire towns are being wiped out on a daily basis. It matters not that the promised savior has yet to show, and hopelessness is spreading across the land.

Your washing machine is busted, and you really need some clean clothes.

Can you complete the journey to your parents' house, and get them to do your laundry?

Embark on this super, deadly-serious adventure, meeting friends, exploring towns, and trying to avoid the battle to save the realm. Because you’re no hero, and you simply don’t have time for that nonsense.

And so what if you're ignoring the world collapsing around you. I mean, what's the worst that could happen?

  • A retro-style Action-Adventure-RPG about trying to get home while the world around you collapses.

  • Earn gold along the way, spending wisely or pissing it away on frivolous junk.

  • Try to survive a land filled with bizarre, angry creatures.

  • Meet friends who may or may not annoy you.

  • Definitely don’t try to help people or save the world.
